snippet.title: United Way of Southeast Louisiana
snippet.description:
OUR MISSION: Eradicate Poverty in Southeast Louisiana

With deep local roots, we see how our communities’ greatest challenges are connected — and how we can bring people and resources together to address them.

That’s why we show up our communities, always listening and ready to respond. Working together with our neighbors, we’re strengthening resilience and advancing health, youth opportunity, and financial security for all. With more than 100 years experience, we share ideas and innovations to drive holistic impact.

Every day, our communities show that when people unite to take action, change is possible. Together, we’re creating a future where everyone, everywhere can reach their full potential.

snippet.title: Zach Of All Trades
snippet.description:
Real-world preparedness for people who don't buy the hype.

I'm Zach. I've been prepping for over a decade, not for the zombie apocalypse, but for the stuff that actually happens: blackouts, grocery shortages, hurricanes, wildfires, inflation, job loss, and the everyday chaos that catches most people with their pants down.

On this channel, you'll get practical, no-nonsense advice grounded in real history and real events, not fear, not gear-obsession, not prepper cosplay. I'll show you what to stockpile, what to skip, how to protect your home and family, and how to stay calm and capable when everyone else is panicking.

If you're tired of fluff listicles and influencers trying to sell you $300 bug-out bags, you're in the right place.
📩 Grab my free 50 Dollar Food Plan: https://zachofalltrades.io/freeplan/

🔔 Subscribe and hit the bell — new videos every week.

For business inquiries: zachprepperrecovery@proton.me

snippet.title: Be Prepared UK
snippet.description:
Be Prepared UK is about sensible, realistic preparedness for everyday people in Britain.

Business contact contact@be-prepared.uk

No bunkers. No camouflage obsession. No pretending the end of the world is coming tomorrow. Just practical advice on dealing with problems that genuinely affect the UK: power cuts, water outages, severe weather, and supply chain disruptions.

We cover what is actually worth preparing for, what equipment is genuinely useful, what is a waste of money, and how to build a 72-hour household emergency plan.

If you’ve never been a “prepper” but wonder if having backup power, dry food storage, and a solid plan makes sense, this channel is for you.


My Website - https://alanlloyd.uk
Download My free Prepping Guides - https://be-prepared.uk/prepping-guides-downloads

Lennie Lawson is a 48-year veteran of the auto industry, a current new car dealer, motivational speaker, and financial coach. He’s a straight shooter who tells it like it is—no fluff, no sales pitch.
